description: Texas motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: To get a Texas Class M license, most applicants must first
options: Complete an approved motorcycle safety course
Hold a car license for at least three years
Pass only the written test at a DPS office
Log 50 supervised riding hours with a parent
questions.explanation: Texas requires an approved motorcycle safety course for a Class M license. A valid motorcycle license from another state can take its place.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Texas?
What does Texas law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Texas: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: In Texas, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Texas issues a motorcycle permit at 15 years at the earliest.
